How to Fail while Preparing for the MCAT

It's very important you overthink it. The practice exams can wait, focus on content review.

A few months ago I took the MCAT for the first time and got a 524. I'm writing this for future test takers, and also as a reminder to myself. Though I won't be taking the MCAT again, I do still have many exams ahead of me and I think this advice is generally applicable.
